# White disappeared! It must have been consumed by the target.
# Current chain: dark gray (21, 8) → orange (18, 24) → dark gray (16, 38) → target
# 
# Let me check the target area to confirm white is gone.
ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("ASCII around target (row 21, col 56):")
for r in range(max(0, 18), min(len(ascii_lines), 25)):
    print(f"  {r}: {ascii_lines[r][50:62]}")

# Let me also check where the white object went by looking for it in segmentation
seg = current_frame.segmentation
white_objs = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
print(f"\nWhite objects: {len(white_objs)}")
for n in white_objs:
    print(f"  pixels={n['pixels']}, center~({sum(b[0] for b in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']):.0f}, {sum(b[1] for b in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']):.0f})")

# Now let me try clicking orange to move it toward the target
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 18, 'col': 24}])
print(f"\nAfter clicking orange:")
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] >= 8 and n['color'] in ['G', 'O', 'W', 'p']:
        rows = [b[0] for b in n['boundary']]
        cols = [b[1] for b in n['boundary']]
        center_r = sum(rows)/len(rows)
        center_c = sum(cols)/len(cols)
        print(f"  color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, center~({center_r:.0f}, {center_c:.0f})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
